title: Lumen packaging definition
$comment: packaging.schema.json — structural contract of packaging/packaging.toml (issue #56, cards 8.E1–8.E3, task W24-C). Mirrors product.schema.json's conventions: data-driven constraints (type, required, additionalProperties, enum, const, minimum, minLength, minItems, pattern) are enforced by scripts/packaging/packaging-env.py's structural pass; cross-file rules (shipped.docs exist in the repo, launch_test.smoke_fixture exists, product identity must NOT appear here) live in the same script's semantic pass. Extensions 'x-lumen-hint' follow product.schema.json's diagnostic convention. Product identity fields (name, version, ids, UpgradeCode) are deliberately ABSENT: they live in product.toml and must never be duplicated here (MP §5 single source of truth).

schema_version.$comment: packaging.toml is born at schema_version 1; bump via a new schema file (packaging.vN.json) plus a migrator, mirroring product.toml's migration contract.

algorithm.$comment: the only algorithm wired into the release manifest writer; adding one means extending the writer first, then this enum (config can never name an unwired algorithm — mirrors product.toml rule F1).

manifest_name.x-lumen-hint: release manifest file name (no slash — it sits flat beside the artifacts).

spec_version.$comment: must match the specVersion the xtask sbom generator emits (tools/xtask/src/cmd/sbom.rs); the generator is the authority, this field only names it for artifact bookkeeping.

artifact_suffix.x-lumen-hint: dotted suffix appended to the artifact base name, e.g. base.sbom.cdx.json.

items.x-lumen-hint: repo-relative doc path with NO whitespace: the bridge exports the list as the space-separated PACKAGING_DOCS env var, so a path containing a space/tab cannot be represented and is refused here — rename the file (constraint documented in docs/packaging/README.md).
items.$comment: repo-relative path; existence checked by packaging-env.py's semantic pass. The charset deliberately excludes EVERY whitespace character (W24-R6 P4-4 / W24-Q): packaging-env.py exports the list as the space-separated PACKAGING_DOCS, so a spaced path would word-split into bogus paths downstream (staging, .wxs File rows) — it is refused loudly here, at validation time (the earliest point every job passes through), with a message naming the config entry. Replacing the space-separated env contract with a richer list format is a deliberate non-goal for now.

install_bindir.x-lumen-hint: FHS staging-relative bin dir, no leading slash.

deb_section.$comment: a valid Debian control Section value.

rpm_release.x-lumen-hint: rpm Release field; plain number or number%{?dist}.

rpm_license.$comment: SPDX license id or rpm license expression; must mirror the repo LICENSE.

universal.$comment: false = two single-arch artifact sets (the documented v1 decision); true = one universal2 binary (lipo of targets) — the flip is documented in docs/packaging/README.md §macOS.

install_bindir.x-lumen-hint: bin dir relative to ProgramFiles64Folder\<Product Name> in the MSI layout.

upgrade_test.$comment: whether the release workflow runs scripts/packaging/test-msi-upgrade.ps1 on the Windows runner.

smoke_verb.$comment: an argv-only CLI host verb that drives the real open path + decoders (decode-bench).

smoke_fixture.$comment: repo-relative media fixture; existence + decodability checked by packaging-env.py's semantic pass and asserted at launch-test time.

desktop_pending_exit.$comment: the desktop skeleton binary's documented exit code (WEBVIEW_PENDING) — asserted as-is until the ADR-004 webview lands.

timestamp_url.$comment: RFC 3161 timestamp server for Authenticode; an http URL is the documented exception (timestamping servers commonly serve plain http; the signature itself protects the timestamp token).

pfx_b64_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the base64 PKCS#12 certificate (secret).

pfx_password_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the PFX passphrase (secret).

identity_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the keychain signing-identity name (secret, optional when a p12 is provided instead).

p12_b64_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the base64 PKCS#12 Developer ID Application certificate (secret).

p12_password_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the p12 passphrase (secret).

notary_key_id_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the App Store Connect API key id (secret).

notary_key_b64_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the base64 .p8 private key (secret).

notary_issuer_env.x-lumen-hint: env var name holding the App Store Connect issuer id (secret).
